name: fleetdeck
description: Fleet Deck — localhost daemon + board for Claude Code, guarded by a release-bound compatibility policy.
author: Luis Morales <luismmorales@gmail.com>

scripts.bundle:
esbuild src/daemon/fleetd.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=src/daemon/fleetd.bundle.mjs --external:bun:sqlite --minify-identifiers --keep-names --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'bun run bundle' — do not edit. Source: src/daemon/*.ts
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:bin: esbuild bin/fleetdeck.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=bin/fleetdeck.mjs --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'bun run bundle:bin' — do not edit. Source: bin/*.ts"
scripts.bundle:hooks: esbuild scripts/fleet-hook.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/fleet-hook.mjs --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'bun run bundle:hooks' — do not edit. Source: scripts/fleet-*.ts" && esbuild scripts/fleet-sessionstart.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/fleet-sessionstart.mjs --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'bun run bundle:hooks' — do not edit. Source: scripts/fleet-*.ts" && esbuild scripts/fleet-watch.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/fleet-watch.mjs --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'bun run bundle:hooks' — do not edit. Source: scripts/fleet-*.ts"
scripts.build:board: cd board && bun install && bun run build
